description: This file defines utility classes and functions for interactions with the Ollama language model API, including error handling, model information retrieval, environment validation, and image data conversion.

classes.name: OllamaError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Ollama-related errors, inherits from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: OllamaModelInfo
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve and manage model information from an Ollama server, including fetching available models and configuration.

methods.name: _convert_image(image)
methods.description: Converts an input image to a base64-encoded JPEG if necessary, otherwise returns the original image string.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_api_key
methods.description: Retrieves the Ollama API key from environment variables, configuration, or secrets manager.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_api_base
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL for Ollama, defaulting to localhost if not set.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_models
methods.description: Fetches a list of available models from the Ollama server or falls back to static list on error.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.validate_environment
methods.description: Performs environment validation; currently a no-op that returns an empty dict.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_base_model
methods.description: Returns the base model name; currently a no-op that returns the input string.
